description: Connect your Earlflow workspace to explore revenue, profit, product performance, advertising, orders, returns, payment fees and supported inventory reports. Compare periods and investigate changes using the same calculations as your Earlflow dashboard. Earlflow provides read-only access to the workspace you choose. Customer contact details and platform credentials are excluded. Requires an existing Earlflow account with access to workspace analytics.

defaultPrompt: Compare last month’s revenue and profit with the previous month and explain the biggest changes.
Which products had the lowest profit last month, and what costs contributed?
Compare my advertising channels last month and explain their attributed revenue, spend and profit.
